fields.climate: cold winters, cool and moist summers; transitional between continental and maritime
fields.resources: timber, peat deposits, small quantities of oil and natural gas, granite, dolomitic limestone, marl, chalk, sand, gravel, clay
fields.farm: milk, sugar beets, potatoes, wheat, triticale, barley, maize, rapeseed, rye, chicken
fields.exports: fertilizers, rapeseed oil, wood, poultry, beef
fields.industries: metal-cutting machine tools, tractors, trucks, earthmovers, motorcycles, synthetic fibers, fertilizer, textiles, refrigerators, washing machines and other household appliances
fields.languages: Russian (official) 71.4%, Belarusian (official) 26%, other 0.3% (includes small Polish- and Ukrainian-speaking minorities), unspecified 2.3%

system.text: presidential republic in name, although in fact a dictatorship

fields.military: 18-27 years of age for compulsory military or alternative service; conscript service obligation is 12-18 months, depending on academic qualifications, and 24-36 months for alternative service…
